crossRefs.note: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…
I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write…
seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

translations.web: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
translations.bsb: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent, we will be in our actions when present.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
translations.asv: Let such a one reckon this, that, what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
